content.text: The redline validated. Submitting the finding.

input.quote: (i) All paragraph headings contained in this Agreement are for convenience only and shall not affect the interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: A text search for "insurance" returns no results, and the General Matters section (p0134-p0136, p0141-p0147, p0149) runs from time-of-essence through entire agreement with no insurance covenant. Garman is a services-touching vendor: it installs the Software at Authorized Locations and converts Sparkling's data (p0041-p0042), and delivers on-site training and implementation support (sec-5, sec-9). With no coverage at all for a vendor that accesses our data and attends our premises, this falls below even the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) and into walk-away territory, so we insert a short insurance paragraph at the preferred limits as new clause 20(k), with workers' compensation and certificates on request. The fallback limits are offered in the comment.

ops.text: (k) Garman shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; and, where Garman processes, converts, hosts or otherwise has access to Sparkling's data, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000. Garman shall also maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. Garman shall provide Sparkling with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage on request.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a short insurance provision, as the Agreement currently contains none even though Garman's personnel attend our sites for installation and training and convert our data. The limits reflect our standard position (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, certificates on request); if helpful we can work from E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M.
proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant (CGL, E&O, cyber, workers' comp) into General Matters.
